title: Capital Cities Challenge
seoDescription: Take an 80-question Capital Cities Challenge covering famous capital cities, country-to-capital matches, region clues, map clues, and city-or-capital questions.
pageTitle: Only 8% Can Pass This Capital Cities Challenge
summary: From famous capital cities to tricky world map clues, see how sharp your global geography knowledge really is.

homepage.title: Can You Pass This Capital Cities Challenge?
homepage.summary: From famous capital cities to tricky world map clues, see how sharp your global geography knowledge really is.

footer.aboutText: This Capital Cities Challenge is designed for entertainment and self-testing. It is not an official geography exam, school assessment, travel qualification, or professional evaluation. The quiz uses broad capital-city questions and simplified explanations.

landing.quickStartText: Start with famous capital cities, then try harder country-to-capital matches, region clues, and city-or-capital questions.

stageGroups.title: Capital Cities Warm Up
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice start. The next round adds more European capital clues.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital of France.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

questions.prompt: Which country has Rome as its capital?
questions.explanation: Rome is the capital of Italy.

questions.prompt: Which country has Ottawa as its capital?
questions.explanation: Ottawa is the capital of Canada.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in Europe?
questions.explanation: Madrid is the capital of Spain in Europe.

questions.prompt: Which option is not a capital city?
questions.explanation: Sydney is not Australia's capital; Canberra is the capital.

questions.prompt: Among these European capitals, which lies furthest north?
questions.explanation: Oslo is farther north than Madrid, Rome, or Athens.

stageGroups.title: Europe Capitals
stageGroups.encouragement: Good map work. Now the challenge moves across the Americas.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Spain?
questions.explanation: Madrid is the capital of Spain.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Sweden?
questions.explanation: Stockholm is the capital of Sweden.

questions.prompt: Which country has Berlin as its capital?
questions.explanation: Berlin is the capital of Germany.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in northern Europe?
questions.explanation: Stockholm is in northern Europe.

questions.prompt: Which of these cities is not a national capital?
questions.explanation: Barcelona is a major city, but Madrid is Spain's capital.

questions.prompt: Which of these capital cities lies furthest west?
questions.explanation: Dublin lies farther west than the other capital cities.

questions.prompt: Which of these southern European capitals lies furthest east?
questions.explanation: Athens is farther east than Lisbon, Madrid, or Rome.

questions.prompt: A clue says: Hungary's capital on the Danube. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Budapest is Hungary's capital and sits on the Danube.

stageGroups.title: Americas Capitals
stageGroups.encouragement: Strong progress. Asia brings a wider mix of capital-city clues.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Mexico?
questions.explanation: Mexico City is the capital of Mexico.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Argentina?
questions.explanation: Buenos Aires is the capital of Argentina.

questions.prompt: Which country has Brasilia as its capital?
questions.explanation: Brasilia is the capital of Brazil.

questions.prompt: Which country has Lima as its capital?
questions.explanation: Lima is the capital of Peru.

questions.prompt: Which of these capital cities is in South America?
questions.explanation: Bogota is the capital of Colombia in South America.

questions.prompt: If you travel south from Mexico toward Central America, which capital fits that region?
questions.explanation: San Jose, the capital of Costa Rica, is in Central America.

questions.prompt: Which capital is closest to the Equator?
questions.explanation: Quito is very close to the Equator.

questions.prompt: A clue says: capital of Cuba, on the north coast of the island. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Havana is the capital of Cuba.

stageGroups.title: Asia Capitals
stageGroups.encouragement: You are halfway warm now. Africa adds another layer of capital knowledge.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Thailand?
questions.explanation: Bangkok is the capital of Thailand.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of South Korea?
questions.explanation: Seoul is the capital of South Korea.

questions.prompt: Which country has New Delhi as its capital?
questions.explanation: New Delhi is the capital of India.

questions.prompt: Which country has Hanoi as its capital?
questions.explanation: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in Southeast Asia?
questions.explanation: Bangkok is in Southeast Asia.

questions.prompt: Which capital is on an island country?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the capital of Japan, an island country.

questions.prompt: Among these Asian capital cities, which lies furthest east?
questions.explanation: Tokyo lies farther east than the other capital cities.

questions.prompt: A clue says: Nepal's capital in a mountain valley. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.

stageGroups.title: Africa Capitals
stageGroups.encouragement: Good focus. The next round checks island and Oceania capitals.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Kenya?
questions.explanation: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Morocco?
questions.explanation: Rabat is the capital of Morocco.

questions.prompt: Which country has Accra as its capital?
questions.explanation: Accra is the capital of Ghana.

questions.prompt: Which country has Addis Ababa as its capital?
questions.explanation: Addis Ababa is the capital of Ethiopia.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in Africa?
questions.explanation: Dakar is the capital of Senegal in Africa.

questions.prompt: Which capital is on Africa's Mediterranean coast?
questions.explanation: Tunis is on the Mediterranean coast.

questions.prompt: Which African city is the odd one out?
questions.explanation: Casablanca is a major city, but Rabat is Morocco's capital.

questions.prompt: A clue says: Senegal's capital on the Atlantic coast. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Dakar is the capital of Senegal.

stageGroups.title: Oceania And Island Capitals
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice work. The next round is built for wait-a-second questions.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.explanation: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.

questions.prompt: Which country has Canberra as its capital?
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital of Australia.

questions.prompt: Which country has Suva as its capital?
questions.explanation: Suva is the capital of Fiji.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in Oceania?
questions.explanation: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea in Oceania.

questions.prompt: Which capital belongs to an island country in the Pacific?
questions.explanation: Apia is the capital of Samoa in the Pacific.

questions.prompt: Which of these cities is not a capital city in Oceania?
questions.explanation: Auckland is not New Zealand's capital; Wellington is.

questions.prompt: Among these Oceania capital cities, which lies furthest south?
questions.explanation: Wellington lies farther south than the other capital cities.

questions.prompt: A clue says: capital of Papua New Guinea. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea.

stageGroups.title: Capital Or Not
stageGroups.encouragement: Sharp elimination. Now use map sense and regional clues.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Ghana?
questions.explanation: Accra is the capital of Ghana.

questions.prompt: Which country has Ankara as its capital?
questions.explanation: Ankara is the capital of Turkey.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in South America?
questions.explanation: Santiago is the capital of Chile in South America.

questions.prompt: Which northern city is not a capital?
questions.explanation: Toronto is not Canada's capital; Ottawa is.

questions.prompt: Which pair is incorrect?
questions.explanation: Canada's capital is Ottawa, not Toronto.

questions.prompt: Which city does not belong with the capital cities?
questions.explanation: Rio de Janeiro is not Brazil's capital; Brasilia is.

questions.prompt: Which Asian city is not a capital?
questions.explanation: Dubai is not the capital of the United Arab Emirates; Abu Dhabi is.

questions.prompt: Of these North American capitals, which lies furthest north?
questions.explanation: Ottawa lies farther north than the other capital cities.

stageGroups.title: Map And Region Clues
stageGroups.encouragement: Excellent. The final two rounds are harder and more mixed.

questions.prompt: Which country has Manila as its capital?
questions.explanation: Manila is the capital of the Philippines.

questions.prompt: Which capital is on the west coast of South America?
questions.explanation: Lima is on Peru's Pacific coast.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in a country that borders Germany?
questions.explanation: Prague is the capital of Czechia, which borders Germany.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in North Africa?
questions.explanation: Rabat is the capital of Morocco in North Africa.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in an island country in the Caribbean?
questions.explanation: Kingston is the capital of Jamaica.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in the Middle East?
questions.explanation: Amman is the capital of Jordan in the Middle East.

questions.prompt: Which of these capitals lies closest to the Equator?
questions.explanation: Quito is very close to the Equator.

questions.prompt: A clue says: Portugal's capital on the Atlantic coast. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Lisbon is Portugal's capital and sits near the Atlantic.

stageGroups.title: Hard Capital Cities
stageGroups.encouragement: Almost there. The final round mixes recall, clues, and comparisons.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Slovenia?
questions.explanation: Ljubljana is the capital of Slovenia.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Nepal?
questions.explanation: Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Jordan?
questions.explanation: Amman is the capital of Jordan.

questions.prompt: Which country has Montevideo as its capital?
questions.explanation: Montevideo is the capital of Uruguay.

questions.prompt: Which country has Ulaanbaatar as its capital?
questions.explanation: Ulaanbaatar is the capital of Mongolia.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in a country that borders both France and Germany?
questions.explanation: Bern is the capital of Switzerland, which borders France and Germany.

questions.prompt: Which of these African cities is not a capital city?
questions.explanation: Lagos is not Nigeria's capital; Abuja is.

questions.prompt: A clue says: capital of Qatar on the Persian Gulf. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Doha is the capital of Qatar.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Uruguay?
questions.explanation: Montevideo is the capital of Uruguay.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Vietnam?
questions.explanation: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.

questions.prompt: Which capital belongs to the United States?
questions.explanation: Washington, D.C. is the capital of the United States.

questions.prompt: Which capital is in a country that borders Spain?
questions.explanation: Lisbon is the capital of Portugal, which borders Spain.

questions.prompt: Which of these cities is not its country's capital?
questions.explanation: Istanbul is not Turkey's capital; Ankara is the capital.

questions.prompt: In this group, which capital city lies furthest south?
questions.explanation: Buenos Aires lies farther south than the other capital cities.

questions.prompt: Which capital city belongs to an island country?
questions.explanation: Reykjavik is the capital of Iceland, an island country.

questions.prompt: A clue says: capital of Greece, famous for the Acropolis. Which answer fits?
questions.explanation: Athens is the capital of Greece.
